intro.text: An Elendel constable who runs the records office at the Fourth Octant precinct.

items.text: A close friend of Captain Reddi and a rival of Marasi, Miklin was assigned to gather material on the dam break near Corbeau, which he considered a waste of time. He grumbled when Marasi came to collect it and asked why she didn't become a prosecutor instead. Yet his dossier was thorough, and it convinced Marasi and MeLaan that the saboteur, Johnst, had been Bleeder.

appearance.text: His hair sticks straight up, like grass sprouting from a pot.

personality.text: Doubtful of Marasi's methods and motives, probably out of resentment over her ties to Aradel and Wax.
